segments.speaker: archivist
segments.text: First Risk Case: The Cellar of the Abominable House. Three half-filled flour sacks conserve volume without faces: Inigo, Belindo, and the witness Flower.

segments.speaker: polo
segments.text: In Checkpoint Lawful A, Inigo holds coiled stillness, then lunges deliberately into Belindo, shattering the oil lamp. Flower retains the complete causal chain, shields Belindo, and enforces Policy P one against Inigo.

segments.speaker: khan
segments.text: Now fork Clinamen Branch A prime. Keep every physical trace in the cellar identical: the eighty-four Newton-second shove, the floor scuff, the spreading oil, and the five ceramic shards. Erase only the shove from Flower's memory.

segments.speaker: polo
segments.text: Seeing only Belindo crash into the flame, Flower recoils into the far corner. Under Policy P three, an honest witness's partial memory hardens into institutional law, billing the victim while the floor scuff stays mute.
